muse_spark_1.3/001: The strategy is central compact connection search with exact LOA rules. All lines are counted to generate exactly-legal moves, friendly jumps allowed, enemy jumps forbidden, captures by landing. Immediate winning moves are played instantly. Otherwise iterative-deepening negamax with alpha-beta finds the move: transposition table, capture-plus-centralization ordering, win-first pruning, time-limited to ~0.9s. Evaluation is relative to player to move: huge mate scores for single 8-connected groups, otherwise weighted difference of number of 8-connected components, average squared spread around centroid, centroid centralization and material, rewarding compact central connected positions and penalizing opponent progress.
muse_spark_1.3/002: The strategy is centralised connectivity search: fast exact move generation for Lines of Action, 8-direction BFS for groups, and negamax alpha-beta with iterative deepening. Evaluation rewards fewer groups, larger main group, low dispersion around the centroid, centralisation, and fewer own pieces, which directly measures how close to single-group connection each side is. Wins are detected immediately after the mover's move, captures are discouraged in ordering because they help the opponent connect, root move ordering and transposition of the previous iteration give strong pruning to reach depth 3-5 in under 1s, with a greedy 1-ply fallback guaranteeing a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/003: The strategy is a time limited negamax search for Lines of Action. Moves are generated by counting pieces on the row, column and two diagonals, forbidding jumps over enemy pieces and landings on friendly pieces. Terminal wins are single 8-connected groups. The heuristic rewards fewer groups, larger largest group, low dispersion around the centroid, centralization and larger opponent piece count, evaluated from the side to move. Root iterative deepening with alpha-beta, capture-first and centralizing move ordering, immediate win detection and timeout fallback guarantees a legal move within 0.9s.
muse_spark_1.3/004: The strategy is centralizing alpha-beta Lines of Action search with connectivity evaluation. Move generation counts pieces on rows columns and both diagonals to get exact LOA distances, forbids jumping over enemies and landing on friendlies. Evaluation compares own versus opponent compactness using number of 8-connected components, Chebyshev MST total, centralisation and piece count, with immediate win/loss detection. Iterative deepening with capture-penalised centre-directed ordering, width limiting and win-in-1 quiescence stays inside 1s and always falls back to a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/005: The strategy is Lines of Action search with connectivity evaluation. Move generation counts pieces on rows, columns and both diagonals to get exact move distance, forbids jumping over enemy pieces and landing on friendly pieces. Terminal wins are single 8-connected groups, mover wins ties and connecting the opponent loses. Evaluation rewards few components, large largest-group ratio, compact centroid spread, centralisation and reversed material, all from side-to-move view. Root uses iterative deepening negamax with alpha-beta, capture plus centre move ordering, and apply plus colour-flip to keep side-to-move as 1, under a strict time budget with always-legal fallback.
